description: This file contains utility functions for handling launcher actions and socket communication in the Cuttlefish Android emulator environment. It includes functions for reading and writing binary data, managing socket connections, and executing launcher commands.

classes.name: LauncherAction
classes.description: Enumeration of launcher actions such as Fail, Powerwash, Restart, Status, Stop, and Extended.

classes.name: LauncherActionInfo
classes.description: Structure holding information about a launcher action, including the action type and optional extended action.

classes.name: LauncherResponse
classes.description: Protobuf message representing the response status from launcher commands.

methods.name: bool IsShortAction(const LauncherAction action)
methods.description: Determines if a given launcher action is considered a short action (like fail, powerwash, restart, status, stop).

methods.name: Result<void> WriteAllBinaryResult(const SharedFD & fd,const T * t)
methods.description: Writes a protobuf message to a file descriptor in binary form. Ensures all bytes are written.

methods.name: Result<bool> ReadExactBinaryResult(const SharedFD & fd,T * t)
methods.description: Reads a protobuf message from a file descriptor in binary form, expecting exact size.

methods.name: Result<RunnerExitCodes> ReadExitCode(SharedFD monitor_socket)
methods.description: Reads the process exit code from a socket.

methods.name: Result<SharedFD> GetLauncherMonitorFromInstance(const CuttlefishConfig::InstanceSpecific & instance_config,const int timeout_seconds)
methods.description: Connects to the launcher monitor socket for a specific instance of the emulator.

methods.name: Result<SharedFD> GetLauncherMonitor(const CuttlefishConfig & config,const int instance_num,const int timeout_seconds)
methods.description: Retrieves the launcher monitor socket for a given configuration and instance number.

methods.name: Result<std::optional<LauncherActionInfo>> ReadLauncherActionFromFd(SharedFD monitor_socket)
methods.description: Reads a launcher action, potentially extended, from a socket.

methods.name: Result<void> WaitForRead(SharedFD monitor_socket,const int timeout_seconds)
methods.description: Waits with a timeout for data to be available to read on a socket.

methods.name: Result<void> RunLauncherAction(SharedFD monitor_socket,const run_cvd::ExtendedLauncherAction & extended_action,std::optional<int> timeout_seconds)
methods.description: Sends a launcher action command through a socket and waits for a success response.

methods.name: RunLauncherAction (overload)
methods.description: Sends an extended launcher action protobuf through a socket and waits for a success response.

ctags.name: GetLauncherMonitor
ctags.signature: (const CuttlefishConfig & config,const int instance_num,const int timeout_seconds)

ctags.name: ReadExactBinaryResult
ctags.pattern: /^static Result<bool> ReadExactBinaryResult(const SharedFD& fd, T* t) {$/

ctags.name: WriteAllBinaryResult
ctags.pattern: /^static Result<void> WriteAllBinaryResult(const SharedFD& fd, const T* t) {$/
